IC1: 1. Patients with CPM [AND] with expected life expectancy of > 6 months.
IC2: 2. ECOG Scale of Performance Status (PS) scores 0 or 1.
IC3: 3. 15 mile catchment area to facilitate overseeing systemic chemotherapy administration
IC4: 4. Concomitant systemic chemotherapy regimens with FOLFIRI, [OR] FOLFOX, [OR] Mitomycin C [OR] &
IC5: Fluorouracil, [OR] Capecitabine (excluding Lonsurf) [OR] or [NOT] without systemic chemotherapy if [NOT] no systemic options available to patient
IC6: 5. Neutrophil count on or just before chemotherapy due date of >1.5
